<!-- A pull request is one of two kinds. Keep the section for yours and
delete the other.

- A design changes one folder, designs/<your-design>/, and nothing else
  (docs/how-to/add-a-design.md).
- A showcase entry changes one folder, showcase/<your-login>/, and nothing
  else (docs/how-to/add-to-the-showcase.md).

For anything else, open an issue first (CONTRIBUTING.md). -->

## A design

- Name:
- What it is, in one line:

- [ ] The pull request changes only `designs/<my-design>/`.
- [ ] I built it and looked at it at a phone's width and a desktop's (docs/how-to/add-a-design.md).
- [ ] It is my own work, or I have the right to every part of it.
- [ ] Every font and image is listed in `design.json` with its licence, and every font ships with its licence text.
- [ ] Any font whose licence reserves its name is the unmodified original.
- [ ] I ran `python tools/check_design.py <my-design>` and it passed, or I could not run it and say so here.
- [ ] I agree that the design is licensed under this repository's MIT licence (CONTRIBUTING.md).

## A showcase entry

- [ ] It is my own site, and its home page links to my GitHub profile.
- [ ] The screenshot is my site's first screen, as I took it.
- [ ] I understand the entry stays in this repository's public history (docs/how-to/add-to-the-showcase.md, "Changing or removing your entry").
